decisions.reason: A hearty bread close to the core assortment costs little to keep, has been listed consistently, and shows no sign that its results can no longer be explained, so a traditional bakery would keep it.
This sweet pastry fits established production and recipes, so keeping it requires no extra justification, though a low visible commitment leaves some chance of quiet rotation out of the range.
A crusty farmhouse bread is a staple that fits the heritage positioning and needs little extra resource, so there is no pressing reason to drop it.
The poppy seed stollen is a publicly showcased flagship with its own page and a gold award, so the firm's visible commitment and good results strongly favor keeping it.
The gold-awarded premium stollen supports the firm's seasonal quality image and has been publicly promoted, making withdrawal unlikely.
